title: Destinies
subtitle: A competitive narrative-driven board game of dark medieval fantasy and personal destiny
tagline: Forge your path, uncover dark secrets, and fulfill your chosen destiny.
loreSummary: You are a traveler adrift in a grim medieval world haunted by pestilence, superstition, and war. Each person bears their own secret destiny, striving to fulfill sacred vows before rivals seal the fate of the realm.
keyFeatures: Scan&Play app-driven narrative mechanics without requiring a game master
Dual-track personal destinies offering branching paths to ultimate victory
Open exploration of grim medieval landscapes and dynamic NPC interactions
Competitive race blending immersive storytelling with tactical resource decisions
